title: Death Wither Sound
description: The Death Sound project adds the iconic Wither spawn sound effect whenever a player dies, recreating the dramatic death effect used on UnstableSMP style servers. Instead of a normal silent death, it plays the sound from UnstableSMP.
body:
Wouldn’t you love to spice up your server’s death scenes a little bit? With this plugin, you can bring in the famous Wither spawn sound effect every single time any player dies on your server, making each death feel like it is happening in _UnstableSMP_.

This is a lightweight plugin with only one function, and it doesn’t require any commands, configurations, or settings. Simply download and install it, and each time a player dies, this awesome sound effect will be triggered instantly!

Be it someone dying in the heat of the battle or being thrown in lava, or whatever other reason a player may die on your server, with this plugin, they will die in a whole different way! Perfect for an SMP, PvP server, or hardcore mode!

**_Features:_**

Wither spawn sound plays when a player dies
Easy to use and set up
Automatically activates upon installation
Adds an intense death scene from _UnstableSMP_
DM "henrikuzas" on discord for help
